item.title: Color Health AI Cancer Care
item.description:
• Summary: Color Health is launching AI-driven virtual clinics for cancer care, aiming to improve access and efficiency. The platform leverages artificial intelligence to assist in diagnosis, treatment planning, and patient monitoring. This initiative represents a growing trend of integrating AI into oncology care delivery.
